title: over the hill
provenance: Reported by luchuyong17 (highball-db#523, 2026-10-17), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 26.6.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT, recipes steam, vcrun2022 and controller-sdl, with SDL 3 and sdl2-compat of their own build through SDL_DYNAMIC_API, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes. klinaker (highball-db#529, 2026-10-17), Apple M3 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r27, D3DMetal 4 beta 2 through the per-game override with -force-d3d11, msync, Retina pixels and the Metal HUD on, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 5 of 5 after 5 minutes with rare stutter. Not verified by the maintainer. Micro-esp (highball-db#575, 2026-10-20), Apple M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 5 of 5, 120 minutes on medium graphics with no issues. OhbananasGaming (highball-db#708, 2026-10-26), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, sync off, rated 5 of 5 after 24 minutes: medium settings play best on an M5, the frame rate drops on higher ones. crtgregoric (highball-db#760, 2026-10-28), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 79 minutes: ran perfectly. nd75ry4jtw-png (highball-db#1013, 2026-11-06), Apple M4, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 24 minutes. bushchannelstepper (highball-db#1233, 2026-11-15), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 67 minutes: an Xbox Series S controller over Bluetooth by the player's words, no issues. Alexpolyech (highball-db#1272, 2026-11-16), Apple M5, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK, rated 4 of 5 after 4 minutes: named over the hill in the report with no Steam id, the copy isn't stated. In the player's words it takes all of the Mac's 24 GB of memory at launch, and with more memory it would be perfect, in an environment that also carries the Counter-Strike 2 recipe, whose dxvk.conf section is for csgo.exe only.
notes: A Unity game. Reported playable on DXMT on an M2 Pro and perfect on an M3 Max on D3DMetal 4 with -force-d3d11, with a rare stutter. Rumble works with an Xbox Series controller over Bluetooth once Wine's controller bus is set to SDL in the right registry key (highball#324), and a DualSense then gives no input in Unity games, see that issue. A base M4 played it for an hour with an Xbox controller over Bluetooth and no issues (highball-db#1233). An M5 with 24 GB rated it playable on DXVK in a 4 minute session, saying it takes all the Mac's memory at launch (highball-db#1272).

knownIssues.symptom: Takes all of a 24 GB Mac's memory at launch, in the player's words (M5, DXVK, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1272)
